title: Double complement in a finite set
statement: Fix a natural number $n$, and for a subset $E \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ write $E^c = \mathrm{Fin}\,n \setminus E$ for its complement. Then for every subset $M \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$, taking the complement twice recovers the original set: $(M^c)^c = M$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a subset of Fin n
